subject: Temporary quota resilience & overrun fee waiver request
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@atlasretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasretail.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short window quota resilience for summer campaign

Hi Rafael,

Quick note — we’re planning a 72-hour lunchtime promotion the week of July 12 that will spike calls to the chat assistants. Our current committed QPS and monthly tokens will likely be exceeded for that window. Can you share options for a short-term quota bump or a guaranteed short-window resilience policy?

Two asks from my side: 1) what’s the uplift to quota and the overrun rate during that 72-hour window; and 2) whether Redwood can do a partial overrun fee waiver or credit considering this is a pilot that could convert to a commitment if the numbers look good.

We’re on a tight procurement timeline, would appreciate a simple cost sheet and any contract amendment language we can circulate to legal.

Thanks —
Sara
Director of Product
AtlasRetail
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short window quota resilience for summer campaign

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the upcoming promotion.

We can do a short-window uplift with a few configurable options depending on how you want to balance cost vs. headroom:

- Option A — Emergency headroom (72 hours): +4x committed QPS, billed at standard overrun rate (0.09 USD per 1k tokens).
- Option B — Buffered headroom (72 hours): +3x committed QPS, with a one-time uplift fee and a 50% discount on overrun above the uplift for the first $5k of overrun charges.
- Option C — Hybrid: +3x with auto-fallback to a lower-cost compatible model if sustained beyond 72 hours; initial $2k credit applied to overrun.

Attached: temporary_quota_adjustment_v1.pdf (proposed amendment + pricing matrix) and atlas_surge_MA_plan.xlsx (sample mutual action plan).

If you’d like a near-final revision to circulate to procurement/legal we can provide DocuSign-ready amendment language and a 3-business-day signature SLA. If this is likely to convert to a committed tier, we can also structure the credit to ladder into a commitment credit on conversion.

Would you like us to hold Option B as the default while you confirm internal approvals?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short window quota resilience for summer campaign

Looping in operations and offering a negotiation suggestion. Rafael — good framing. A few commercial points we should consider before we finalize Option B for Atlas: 

- We can offer a one-time 60% discount on overrun unit price for the first $4,000 of charges (rather than $5k) if Atlas agrees to sign the short amendment and commit to a 6-month evaluation window to convert (no hard commit required, but active conversion discussions within 90 days).
- We should cap total uplift hours at 84 (to give a 12 hr buffer) and ensure auto-fallback rules are explicit.
- We can tie the credit to the HubSpot deal (RDW-ATLAS-2027-05) so internal finance can track redemption.

Monica — can you confirm operational feasibility (billing hook, metering labels, and quick-runbook for SRE/CS) and if we can get DocuSign template ready?

Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short window quota resilience for summer campaign

All sounds doable. Operational notes: 

- Billing: we can attach an ad-hoc credit code (ATLAS-SURGE-2027) and apply the negotiated discount on the first $4,000 of overrun tokens. Finance will ingest via the HubSpot deal id.
- Metering: we’ll create a temporary route tag (atlas_promo_jul12) so logs and cost show cleanly in the Console.
- SRE/CS: recommend a pre-warm two-day window before the promotion start to prime KV caches; we’ll schedule a deployment freeze during the event window.
- DocuSign: I’ll drop the amendment (Option B w/ Ben’s 60% tweak -> final will reference HubSpot deal and the ATLAS-SURGE-2027 credit). Expect a PowerForm link in ~2 hours.

Monica Patel
Customer Success
From: Sara Lim <sara@atlasretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short window quota resilience for summer campaign

Thanks everyone — this looks great. We’re happy to proceed with Option B as updated (60% off overrun unit price for first $4k, max 84 hours headroom, auto-fallback to the compatible model). Please send the DocuSign amendment and we’ll get procurement to review today.

Signed-off-by: Sara Lim

--
Sara Lim
Director of Product
AtlasRetail
Documentation: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-ATLAS-01
